conceptZh: 玩具機器人打開一支胖手電筒，興奮地照來照去，最後不小心照到自己眼睛、瞇成一條線；他關掉手電筒後，光束收成上面的兩點與短豎，手電筒身體壓成中間那一橫，他的兩條腿則變成下面的「儿」，合成「光」。
object: a small toy robot and a chunky toy torch
morph: the beam folds into the two dots and short upright on top, the torch body flattens into the horizontal bar, and the robot’s legs become the two strokes of 儿 below, forming 光
creativeAngle: 孩子喜歡的英雄裝備感，笑點是「照到自己眼睛」這個每個小孩都做過的蠢事，非常有共鳴。光只有六畫，可以完整組裝，而且手電筒的光束、筒身、雙腳正好對上上中下三段筆劃。語音詞「月光」，月ㄩㄝˋ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale slate background. Centered stands a small boxy toy robot holding a chunky yellow toy torch in both hands. At 0.6 seconds he clicks it on and a soft, clean beam appears. From 0.8 to 2.2 seconds he sweeps it about with mounting excitement - across the floor, up high, in a little circle, faster and faster, thrilled with himself. At 2.4 seconds he spins the torch around to check whether it is still working and shines it straight into his own eyes. He goes completely still, visor squeezed into two thin slits, and slowly lowers the torch. Beat. At 3.2 seconds he clicks it off and the shapes settle: the beam folds up into two neat dots with a short upright between them at the top of frame, the torch body flattens into one clean horizontal bar beneath them, and the robot's two legs stretch down and straighten into a matching pair of strokes below. By 4.8 seconds everything has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 光 in saturated deep teal, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins, its two top dots, short upright, long horizontal and two lower strokes all crisp and clearly separated. From 4.9 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 光 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「光、光、月光」, using the reading ㄍㄨㄤ for 光 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 光 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 月光 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 光: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
